notes: Recorded 16 master's programmes and 15 PhD programmes, the full table on the KAUST programmes-of-study page. The page headline says "17 STEM disciplines" but its table lists 16 programmes; the master's page also says 17 subjects. Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship is MS only; 8 programmes have an integrated MS/PhD route (Applied Mathematics and Computational Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Crop Science and Biotechnology, Statistics).

The table now shows "Life Sciences and Bioengineering" and "Crop Science and Biotechnology", replacing the earlier stored names Bioengineering, Bioscience and Plant Science. The older KAUST menu pages still show Plant Science (PS), Bioscience and Bioengineering under Life Sciences and Bioengineering, Earth System Science and Engineering (ESSE) and Materials Science and Engineering and Applied Physics (MSEAP); the programmes-of-study table names are used here and the differences are noted for editors.

The old menu groups programmes by academic division: Biological and Environmental Science and Engineering (Environmental Science and Engineering, Marine Science, Plant Science), Biomedical Sciences (Life Sciences and Bioengineering), Computer, Electrical and Mathematical Science and Engineering (Applied Mathematics and Computational Science, Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Statistics) and Physical Science and Engineering (Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Earth System Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering and Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering); the programmes-of-study table does not name divisions.
MS entry is Fall 2027 only; PhD entry is Spring and Fall 2027 for every PhD programme in the table.
not_stated: Divisions or faculties on the programmes-of-study page.
The 17th discipline the page headline counts.
